description: This file defines a PHP class 'HelpController' that extends 'AbstractVueController' and manages help-related redirection logic within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the 'HelpService' to validate URLs and generate redirect URLs based on user requests.

classes.name: HelpController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling help-related redirection requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHelpService
methods.description: Provides an instance of the HelpService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to determine if a help URL is valid, and redirects accordingly, handling exceptions and access restrictions.
